quickAnswer: The Wetherspoons fried buttermilk chicken burger costs a typical {price}, has {calories} kcal and comes with lettuce, tomato and mayonnaise in a soft bun, alongside chips. taste:
This burger centres on the contrast between crunchy seasoned breading and juicy, tender chicken breast. The buttermilk marinade is part of the chicken preparation, while the coating supplies the most noticeable crunch. A soft bun gives way more readily than the crisp exterior, so the textures stay distinct rather than feeling uniform. It is a comforting alternative to a beef burger, with the chicken taking the lead.

Lettuce adds fresh crispness, and the tomato brings a fresh element alongside the creamy mayonnaise. That mayonnaise softens the overall impression without replacing the coating's crunch. Served hot with chips, the plate suits someone who values texture as much as flavour.
